messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €137.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
Building on your third package, we can accept the effective date of 01 April 2027 and 45 days payment terms at a revised price of €137.90 per unit.
Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown, though as a family-run foundry, our detailed internal cost structures remain confidential.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Building on your second package, we welcome the 14-day payment term, which enables us to offer a revised price of €132.40 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

This Angebot is a price of €132.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. It stays valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing cooperation and trust this significant movement demonstrates our commitment to finding a fair agreement between our two houses.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our traditional foundry values the strong, long-standing relationship between our houses, and we appreciate your continued willingness to offer faster payment terms, which we value. Building on your second package, we can make a further concession to €131.70 per unit. This represents a significant step from our side to reach a fair agreement that works for both our houses.

Our offer stands at a price of €131.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust that this proposal reflects our deep commitment to our shared future and our dedication to providing you with the finest craftsmanship from our region. We look forward to your positive response.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
